subject: general
question: Who among the following has been authorised to act as the Chairperson, Lokpal, with effect from 28 May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Pradip Kumar Mohanty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Pradip Kumar Mohanty has been authorised to act as the Chairperson of **Lokpal** from 28 May 2022.
 
• The Lokpal is an anti-corruption ombudsman established under the **Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013**.
 
• Justice Pradip Kumar Mohanty was a judicial member of Lokpal before assuming the role of Acting Chairperson.
 
• The position of Chairperson is significant in overseeing inquiries into allegations of corruption against public servants and ensuring accountability.
 
• The Lokpal is composed of a Chairperson and eight members, including judicial and non-judicial representatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013**

 
 
• It provides for the establishment of Lokpal at the national level and Lokayuktas at the state level to investigate allegations of corruption against public officials.
 
• The Act covers complaints against public servants, including the Prime Minister (with specific conditions).
 
• The Lokpal has the power to prosecute public servants and recommend disciplinary actions.
 
• The Act mandates transparency and accountability in governance to curb corruption.
 
 
 
• **Structure of Lokpal**
 
 
• Lokpal consists of a Chairperson and eight members (four judicial and four non-judicial).
 
• The Chairperson is either a former Chief Justice of India, a Supreme Court judge, or an eminent person with expertise in anti-corruption policies.
 
• Members are appointed based on qualifications and experience in legal and public administration fields.
 
 
 
• **Jurisdiction of Lokpal**
 
 
• The Lokpal has jurisdiction over public servants, including Ministers, Members of Parliament, and officials under the Central Government.
 
• It can investigate cases of corruption involving public servants but excludes certain cases related to international relations or national security.
 
 
 
• **Procedure for Inquiry**
 
 
• Lokpal receives complaints and conducts preliminary inquiries to determine the validity of allegations.
 
• If sufficient grounds exist, a formal investigation is initiated, which may involve agencies such as the CBI or other investigative bodies.
